items.name: The Drowned Cradle: Lantern drop 30% to 10% + The Closing Hold: unhide + The Drowned Cradle: pyramid description (2 line + The Drowned Cradle: 5 salvage on each of 1 win(s) + scene character

objectives.description: The lower hatch opens on a hold that is still being built. Somewhere below, a mallet is working, steady as a heartbeat, and the walls are a little closer every time it lands.
The Mender's Apprentice looks up from his planks. "You're standing where the wall goes."
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the hold closes over it.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hold closes behind you.

objectives.description: The hold is narrower than it was a minute ago. Two bilge hands are snapping tarred lines across the boards, and wherever a line lands, the deck splits.
The Bilge Caulker and the Pump Hand call their sides.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the hold closes over it.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hold closes behind you.

objectives.description: The keel room. A broad, stooped shipwright sets down a plank and turns around, a skyglass mallet on his shoulder. "Mind your feet. The hull's coming in."
The Hullbound Mender lifts his mallet, and the hold begins to close.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the hold closes over it.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the hold closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Mender lowers his mallet. "...Leave it open. Just this once." The walls stop moving, and the hold's stores are yours.
The hold closes over you, and the Mender goes back to his planks.

data.description:
Down in the lower hold, the ship's master carpenter is still mending.
3 fights · final boss: The Hullbound Mender

items.name: The Spoiled Hold: unhide + The Spoiled Hold: pyramid description (2 lines) + The Spoiled Hold: level 30+, no max + The Spoiled Hold: 1 salvage on each of 2 win(s); 1 chart pick(s) removed, U2yJb  + scene character

data.description:
The crew still stand their posts in the deep hold, and the rot stands with them.
3 fights · final boss: Rot-Touched Core Horror · burn the rot out for 1 more

objectives.description: The bilge is ankle-deep in green water. A Deck Warden wades through it on his rounds with a Seal Charge bobbing at his heel, and the boards bend under him like wet bread.
The Deck Warden and his Seal Charge hold the bilge.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The stores beyond have gone soft. Crates sag into the deck, and a Skyglass Sentinel stands guard over them, its glass clouded through with rot.
The Rot-Touched Sentinel steps off its post.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: At the bottom of the hold the rot has grown into a wall of wet timber and cloudy skyglass, knit together. Behind it something large is still being rebuilt. You can burn the rot out and take what feeds it, or find a way around.
The burning wall stands up and fights back.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The wall falls into ash, and a lump of Core Rot rolls loose from it, still warm. Beyond the ash, the Core Horror is pulling itself out of the frame.
The Rot-Touched Core Horror rises, dripping green.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: You find a crawlway along the keel and come out behind the wall, where the Core Horror is pulling itself out of the frame.
The Rot-Touched Core Horror rises, dripping green.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Core Horror sinks back into the rot, and the wall you burned stays burned. You carry the stores out, and the warm lump of Core Rot with them.
The Core Horror sinks back into the rot. The deep hold's stores are yours.
The rot closes over you, and the hold takes back what you came for.

items.name: The Rotted Galley: unhide + The Rotted Galley: pyramid description (2 lines) + The Rotted Galley: level 30+, no max + The Rotted Galley: 1 salvage at 25% on each of 1 win(s); 1 chart pick(s) removed + scene character

data.description:
The cooks are still at work, feeding a crew that has not eaten in a generation.
3 fights · final boss: First Blade

objectives.description: The galley fires are still lit. An Arsenal Keeper counts sacks of rice gone black, checking them off a list no one will read.
The Arsenal Keeper reaches for his charges.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: In the mess, a Deck Warden and an Oathkeeper sit at a table set for forty, waiting for a meal that keeps spoiling on the plates.
They stand, as if the bell had rung.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The cold room is the worst of it, green to the ceiling. The First Blade guards the last good stores, as if someone might still come down for them.
The First Blade draws.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The cold room is quiet. You carry out what the rot hadn't reached yet.
The galley keeps you, and the stores stay where they are.

items.name: The Glass Nursery: unhide + The Glass Nursery: pyramid description (2 lines) + The Glass Nursery: level 81+, no max + The Glass Nursery: 3 salvage on each of 1 win(s) + scene character

data.description:
Below the reliquary is a room the ship's builders never drew, and it is still being kept.
2 fights · final boss: Veteran First Blade

objectives.description: The door is skyglass, soft at the edges as if it were poured yesterday. Small thumbprints are pressed into it in a neat row, one for every frame in the room beyond.
The Sealwright's echo steps out of the nearest frame to stop you.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: Rows of frames stand in the dark, each holding a face, half set. Somewhere a woman is humming. Every time you move, the humming stops, and a voice says, kindly, 'Hold still.'
Each frame has a label in the same neat hand: a name, a date and one word. Nearly all of them carry the same date. The word is always 'kept.'
The humming leads to an empty chair beside the largest frame. A folded fan lies on the seat. The glass in the frame is still warm, as if someone had just been leaning on it.
The First Blade's echo comes out of the warm frame, and it does not blink.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the chart's way closes.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the way back closes behind you.

objectives.description: The echoes break, and the frames fill again behind you, one face at a time. On your way out you notice a new thumbprint in the soft glass of the door. It is yours.
You hold still. The humming starts again.

items.name: The Split Hold: salvage reset to 1 at 25% on each of 2 win(s); 3 chart pick(s) removed; Shoal/Stern boss names + The Split Hold: unhide, level 30+, no max

objectives.description: The Split Hold lies on its side in the shallows, the sea running in and out of it. A Faded Deck Warden keeps the hatch with a Seal Charge, both still dripping.
The Deck Warden plants himself in the hatch.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: Below, the stores are knee-deep in seawater. An Arsenal Keeper counts the crates that are left, and he does not like your face.
The Arsenal Keeper reaches for his charges.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: At the bottom the hull has cracked clean in two. To port, a Skyglass Sentinel and the First Blade hold the armory. To starboard, a Wayfinder bends over a soaked chart while an Oathkeeper stands over him.
The Sentinel's glass flares, and the First Blade steps in behind it.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Wayfinder marks you on his chart, and the Oathkeeper raises his blade.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The armory is yours, what the sea left of it.
The Wayfinder's chart is ruined, but the stores behind him are not.
The sea pours into the hold behind you, and the run is over.

items.name: The Broken Stern: salvage reset to 1 on each of 1 win(s); 1 chart pick(s) removed; Shoal/Stern boss names + The Broken Stern: unhide, level 30+, no max

objectives.description: The Broken Stern has run aground on the bar, upright, as if she were still under way. Two Faded Deck Wardens and a Seal Charge hold the gangway.
The Deck Wardens close ranks on the gangway.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: In the chart room a Faded Oathkeeper guards the Wayfinder, who is still plotting a course for a ship that is not moving.
The Oathkeeper steps between you and the Wayfinder.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: Below, something heavy moves in the flooded hold. The Core Horror has come in with this piece of her, smaller than the one in the deep, and just as hungry. Watch the floor: red means move.
The Shoal Core Horror rises out of the bilge.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: At the helm the Captain stands with both hands on the wheel, steering a stern that has no ship in front of it. He turns his head. "You're not on my roster."
The Stern Captain lets go of the wheel.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Captain fades with his hands back on the wheel. The stern is quiet, and the tide lifts her a little, as if she were finally free to go.
The stern keeps her crew, and you wash back up on the sand.
